Silverquill should recognize spoken, written, signed, or ink/light language as a magical and social method.

Silverquill can express influence through visible leadership, style, drive, and competition.
Silverquill placement should ask whether words alter status, trust, pressure, or the social situation.

Silverquill evidence supports words used to lead, uplift, criticize, intimidate, compete, or pressure without requiring unsupported Radiance/Shadow shorthand.
Legal or procedural language alone should not be treated as Silverquill without rhetorical, social, or word-magic evidence.
